items.html: It is found that the Chokhma in Netzach, and the Chokhma in Chesed, and the Chokhma in Chokhma, of the middle aspect, were revealed and grew. And likewise the Bina in Hod, and the Bina in Gevura, and the Bina in Bina. And the Daat in Yesod, and the Daat in Tifferet, and the Daat in Daat grew. And behold, the nine articles of the middles were completed, all of which are only the three Sefirot ChGT, and a third grew in them now; and then the full stature of the man was completely completed. And also in the external aspects, their KHB grew, in the aforementioned manner as in the middle. And behold, now the Gadlut was completed in them: nine articles of KHB within nine articles of ChGT within nine articles of NHY; however, they are only nine Sefirot, and in each one three articles. Behold, all these are aspects in ZA, mentioned in the previous chapters.
